subject: Dovetail MAP: orchestration, canary windows & training cadence
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Dovetail MAP: orchestration, canary windows & training cadence

Alex / Maya —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get Orpheus live on Redwood. Attached is a first-pass Dovetail MAP (Orpheus_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout phases, canary windows, migration cutover, and training cadence. High level: 

- Training: a two-day trainer + hands-on cohort for product & ops (recommended afternoons to avoid daily batch windows).
- Canary: a guarded weekend window with a subset of production traffic (~10% initially) and a 48h observation period.
- Migration cutover: rolling cutover with feature-flagged endpoints and a fallback to pre-existing model layer.
- Evaluation plan: prompt set and pass/fail criteria attached (eval_prompt_set_v1.jsonl).

Key asks from your side: confirm 1) the preferred canary weekend, 2) three SMEs for training, and 3) final acceptance SLA gates (latency, error-rate, quality degradation thresholds).

Proposed dates (please indicate conflicts):
- Trainer sessions: May 17–18 (2 afternoons, 2:00–5:00 PT)
- Canary window (option A): May 24–26 (Fri–Sun)
- Migration cutover (if canary passes): May 31–Jun 1
- Acceptance testing: Jun 2–3 (smoke + regression + quality eval)

If those dates conflict, we can shift one week; we want to lock the MAP this week so SRE and Dedicated capacity can schedule reserved pool provisioning.

Attachments: Orpheus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), eval_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (eval prompts), canary-checklist.pdf (operational checklist stub)

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben for capacity confirmation.

—Priya

Subject: Re: Dovetail MAP: orchestration, canary windows & training cadence — agreed timeline

Alex / Maya —

Thanks for the quick responses. To reconcile schedules, proposed (final) timeline below — please confirm sign-off by end of week so we can book facilities and SRE resources: 

Agreed dates (final):
- Trainer sessions (rehearsal + team training): May 18–19, 1:00–4:00 PT (two afternoons)
- Reserved rehearsal (dry run on reserved canary pool): May 24 (full day) — internal only
- Canary window (production guarded rollout): May 31–Jun 2 (Mon–Wed) — ramp to ~10% traffic, 48h observation
- Migration cutover: Jun 3–4 (organized rolling cutover, feature-flag based)
- Acceptance tests and quality evaluation: Jun 5 (smoke + automated evals using eval_prompt_set_v1.jsonl)

Why this compromise: Ben can provision the pool by May 20 if training is on the 18–19 slot; Alex, this gives you a rehearsal 1 week before the canary and moves the guarded window slightly later to accommodate your audit.

Acceptance gates (to sign-off on go-live):
- p95 latency <= 450ms on 1k sample traffic
- 5xx <= 0.25% sustained over 6h
- No >3% negative delta on the core eval groups (quality) vs baseline
- Successful end-to-end end user flow (manual checklist + smoke)

Monitoring & rollback: Redwood will enable automated regression alerts (Slack + email), token-level cost dashboards, and an automated fallback policy to the previous model variant if quality thresholds are breached during the canary. Full rollback playbook attached (canary-checklist.pdf).

Next steps / action owners: 
- Alex / Orpheus: confirm SMEs for training (Maya + 1) — due EOD Thu 5/7
- Priya: finalize MAP workbook and update HubSpot (link below)
- Ben: confirm reserved pool provisioning ticket and Slack channel for canary ops by Wed 5/6

Links & docs: https://hubspot.example/deal/ORP-2026-0427, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_Orpheus-MAP, DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABC12345

Attachments: Orpheus_MAP_v1.xlsx, eval_prompt_set_v1.jsonl, canary-checklist.pdf

If everyone is good, I’ll create the mutual action plan in Drive and set calendar invites for training. Please reply with a short "+1" to confirm.
